answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, converted to a slow vesting stream, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Reaching the umber of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The grove is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the willow. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
